definitions.gloss: baseball team; ball club; baseball franchise
definitions.explanation: A professional baseball team or organization. In Japan, this refers specifically to the twelve professional baseball teams in Nippon Professional Baseball (NPB), which are divided into the Central League and Pacific League.

examples.japanese: {好|す}きな{球団|きゅうだん}はどこですか。
examples.english: Which baseball team do you support?

examples.japanese: その{選手|せんしゅ}は{他|ほか}の{球団|きゅうだん}にトレードされた。
examples.english: That player was traded to another team.

examples.japanese: {日本|にほん}のプロ{野球|やきゅう}には{十二|じゅうに}{球団|きゅうだん}があり、セ・リーグとパ・リーグに{分|わ}かれている。
examples.english: Japanese professional baseball has twelve teams, divided into the Central League and Pacific League.

notes:
USAGE:
{球団|きゅうだん} is the standard term for a professional baseball organization in Japanese. It refers to the franchise as a whole, including the front office, not just the playing roster. Japan has twelve NPB {球団|きゅうだん}, each owned by a major corporation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {球団|きゅうだん}オーナー (team owner)
- {球団|きゅうだん}{職員|しょくいん} (team staff)
- {親|おや}{会社|がいしゃ} (parent company — of a baseball franchise)
- {十二|じゅうに}{球団|きゅうだん} (the twelve NPB teams)
